primary_papers.title: Anisotropies in Scalar-Induced Gravitational-Wave Background from Inflaton-Curvaton Mixed Scenario with Sound Speed Resonance

source_chunks_or_sections.quote_or_summary: The paper proposes a new SSR inflaton-curvaton model and connects amplified perturbations to PBH dark matter.
The model contains an inflaton, curvaton, oscillating sound speed, and amplified curvature perturbations.
The paper estimates f_PBH about 1 at the benchmark and notes PBHs could account for all cold dark matter.

caveats: PBH abundance and mass mapping are extracted from the paper text only and should be checked by a human expert.
